training_guidance: When modeling shafts, reference TAB sheets 001-018 for feature-specific standards including grooves, seal seats, bearing seats, threads, and chamfers
When modeling gears and planetary components, reference Family sections 66xxx for component-specific standards

Keyway standards are defined in TAB 014
Assembly and sectional drawing conventions are specified in TAB 097 and TAB 098
All shaft variants (solid, hollow, splined, piston) have dedicated family code standards in the 66xxx series
summary: This is the main index page (MTQ-001, page 1/3) of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook dated 26.10.2010. The document is structured into TAB sheets covering machining features and processes (TAB 001-098), and Family sections organized by component codes (66xxx series) covering specific shaft types, gears, and planetary components. The index provides a comprehensive roadmap to all technical standards for designing and manufacturing power transmission components.
